name: chemistryuno-mendeleef

scripts.build:backend: cd backend && set CGO_ENABLED=0 && go build -o chemistryuno.exe main.go
scripts.backend: cd backend && set CGO_ENABLED=0 && go run main.go
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['backend/chemistryuno.db', 'backend/chemistryuno.exe', 'dist'].forEach(f => { try { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { if (fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()) { fs.rmSync(f, {recursive: true}); } else { fs.unlinkSync(f); } } } catch(e) {} })"
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && cd frontend && rimraf node_modules dist .vite

description: Chemistry UNO V1.0.0 Mendeleef - 化学元素版UNO游戏 (正式版)
author: TomKe & Copilot
